messages:
Maria: Quick sync — we need to finalize the RFC review order for Wednesday's 2-hour block. Thinking staggered starts (30m per author) so reviewers can hop between lanes without collisions.
Alex: Staggered makes sense. timezone note: Priya is +5:30, I’m -7. Can we put her first or last?
Priya: I can do early (my morning) or late (my evening). Either works. prefer early if it helps reviewers.
Jorge: I’m flexible but prefer not to be the very first. Also request a 10m buffer between talks for quick recaps/questions.
rfc-bot: Reminder: post pre-reads 24h before slot or thread will be deprioritized.
Maria: Proposed order (draft):
```
1) Priya — 10:00 PT (30m)
2) Alex  — 10:40 PT (30m)
3) Jorge — 11:20 PT (30m)
buffer windows: 10m between each
```
Alex: Can we flip Alex/Jorge if Jorge needs a later time? I can swap.
Priya: 10:00 PT works for me. I’ll upload the pre-read by EOD tomorrow.
Maria: Please claim reviewer lanes here: frontend / infra / cost. Ideally at least two reviewers per RFC.
Jorge: Claiming infra + cost.
Alex: I’ll take frontend + UX.
Maria: Great. @CalendarBot can you create tentative events and include a zoom link + agenda placeholder?
CalendarBot: Event created: "RFC Review — Wed" 10:00–12:00 PT, guests: Maria, Alex, Priya, Jorge. Zoom link in event description.
Maria: Thanks. Everyone — drop a one-line summary of your pre-read in this thread when uploaded. We'll reorder only if a reviewer conflict comes up. :thumbsup:
